Universal (Intel and Apple silicon), ad-hoc signed, macOS 13 or newer.

Download `MacClock.zip`, unzip, and drag `MacClock.app` to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, right-click the app and choose Open, or run:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/MacClock.app

See [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/sduemler/MacClock/blob/main/INSTALL.md) for full setup.
